subject: FLAG-14 directive
notes:
kb/Work PB1374 (w1020f). Printed format rendered from the canonical PDF (p.102, folio 72): `>> FLAG-14 { ALL | { |twelve options| } } { ON | OFF }` with FLAG-14, every option word and OFF underlined and ALL and ON NOT (the spec figure note agrees; its closing sentence calling the ON/OFF braces 'required' contradicted its own first paragraph and is corrected in specs/ISO_COBOL.md). cite.py --check 5.2.3, 5.2.6.3, 5.2.6.4 and 7.3.15.4 'If ON is explicitly or implicitly specified for an option' OK. TryParse now accepts `>>FLAG-14 VALUE-ZERO`, `>>FLAG-14 ALL`, `>>FLAG-14 ON`, `>>FLAG-14 OFF` and a bare `>>FLAG-14` (ALL and ON are the defaults, 5.2.6.3), and refuses `>>FLAG-14 VALUE-ZERO VALUE-ZERO ON` (5.2.6.4) with COBOL1622. Before: the first five drew COBOL1622 and the repeat compiled clean. [editions: a 2023 introduction (7.3.15.1); COBOL0900 below 2023]
